name: GetAiApiKey
description: A single-model OpenAI-compatible API with a short introductory trial.
overview: New accounts can claim $0.50 in trial credit on the API-key page without a card; it expires seven days after signup. The operator calls its sole model uncensored but does not identify its underlying weights. No account, balance or inference was tested.
free_access: $0.50 one-time trial; claim on key page
One hosted model; identity not published
notes: Base URL https://api.getaiapikey.com/v1. Trial is finite; paid top-ups are separate.
